title: NASA DART mission hits Dimorphos

tellings.quote: I looked at the NASA dart mission and you know that was a spacecraft uh I think was knocking into Dorphice
DART program aimed to prove that humans can deflect asteroids with satellites and prevent Earth impact
tellings.difference: Frames it as proving that humans can deflect asteroids and spans 2021-2022.
tellings.link_reason: The same NASA DART mission that struck Dimorphos to test asteroid deflection.

plain: In 2022, NASA's DART mission flew a spacecraft into Dimorphos, a small moon of the asteroid Didymos, to show that humans can push an asteroid off course and keep it from hitting Earth. Michels brings it up himself on two episodes, once while talking to Randall Carlson and once while talking to Graham Hancock. In one he recalls it loosely as a spacecraft "knocking into" the asteroid. In the other he describes it as a test of asteroid deflection that ran from 2021 to 2022.
